source: Open-Meteo historical archive (ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis, ~0.1-0.25 deg cell over the watershed), hourly precipitation; antecedent wetness = 30-day API from the same series through wetness.wetness_from_api; trip lines = readiness.trip_inches at that wetness
caveat: A modeled record, not gauges: one reanalysis cell covers all eight basins, and ERA5 under-catches mountain rain (Helene here reads ~9 in against 11-14 in observed in Jackson County). Wetness is the model's, not measured. The rung is the engine's rung for that rain at that wetness.

hydro.engine: cwm_model real-hyetograph chain (assess_event as a time series)
hydro.wetness_source: validated antecedent (K24A hourly hyetograph scaled to the 10 in basin total (peak 0.66 in/h))
hydro.rain_source: K24A hourly hyetograph scaled to the 10 in basin total (peak 0.66 in/h), antecedent wetness 0.25 (drought-dry) — the backtest_helene.py forcing, which reproduces the five NCGS surveyed Helene high-water marks to within 0.3-0.5 ft (HELENE_DECISION, 2026-07-31)

CC-WCU-2260.source: peak implied by the NCGS surveyed Helene marks (~10-yr) through the reach rating; no gauge at campus

CC-SPD-1830.source: FIMAN 25380 measured: Helene peak 8.86 ft gage height, 2.50 at low flow (6.36 ft rise); modeled stage is in the same frame

forcing.rain: K24A hourly hyetograph scaled to the 10 in basin total (peak 0.66 in/h), antecedent wetness 0.25 (drought-dry) — the backtest_helene.py forcing, which reproduces the five NCGS surveyed Helene high-water marks to within 0.3-0.5 ft (HELENE_DECISION, 2026-07-31)

note_days: wetness_by_day[d] / trip_by_day[d] = state at the start of replay day d (API through the previous day)
hydro_note: hydro.basins[bid].stage_ft / posture are hourly from replay hour 0; first.* = hour each rung was first reached; notice_hr = first WATCH minus the gate-crossing hour (negative = WATCH before the track crossed the gate). One CN per storm from the record wetness on the day the main rain began, or the validated antecedent where a storm carries a 'forcing' block (Helene: K24A 10 in at wetness 0.25, the backtest forcing that matches the NCGS marks; cum_in is then that hyetograph spliced into the ERA5 window and cum_in_era5 keeps the reanalysis).
